Every sub-account with no level of its own inherits this one. Change the default first.
Built-in level
Assistant, Operator and Builder can be edited, but not renamed, rebased or archived.
That level is archived

That access level no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
A bulk change is already running
Wait until it finishes before changing access again. Another change now would overwrite this one.
